title: krmn K2: join_welcome checks this identity's own leaf (rule 4)
description: mls-extensions #110 rule 4: a client MUST NOT join a group whose GroupContext requires a component it does not support. join_welcome excludes its own leaf today (member.rs:96-97, 303-304); check it before into_group (member.rs:664-667) and refuse. Regression test first (mls-rs creator whose GroupContext requires a component our leaf lacks). See krmn design.
notes: 2026-11-02 K2 done in worktree agent-a3f0d53ed19e277ed (uncommitted): join_welcome checks this identity's own leaf (StagedWelcome::own_leaf_node, check_leaf against required_lists) before into_group stores the group; refuses with MissingSafeAadComponent/MissingAppComponent. Docs/Limitations updated (module Required components, Limitations, join_welcome errors, WelcomeJoin.nonconforming_leaves). Test member_mls_rs.rs join_welcome_refuses_a_group_requiring_a_component_our_leaf_lacks (mls-rs creator; safe_aad 0x0021 and app_components 0x8001 cases; asserts Member::load -> GroupNotFound) failed first (join succeeded). No existing test changed. Six gates pass (93 suites). Note: OpenMLS deletes a one-time KeyPackage while building the StagedWelcome (creation.rs ~706-713), before any mimid check, so a refused join still consumes it; pre-existing for every refused Welcome join, out of K2 scope.
